chunks.text: Purpose. This policy establishes requirements for access control at Northwind Fabrication. It applies to all employees, contractors, and systems. Exceptions require CISO approval.

Workday is the source of truth for who works at Northwind. A nightly sync creates an Active Directory account only for a person with an active Workday worker record, after the manager approves the ServiceNow request.

Name | Department | Role | Enclave
J. Ortiz | Engineering | CAD designer | CUI
A. Chen | Quality | Inspector | CUI
M. Patel | Finance | AP clerk | Corporate
svc_erp runs the Epicor ERP integration under a managed service account. svc_backup runs Veeam backup jobs. Each service account lists its owner and the scheduled task that runs as it.

Only the jobs on this list run unattended on CUI servers: the nightly Veeam backup (svc_backup) and the hourly Epicor sync (svc_erp). AppLocker blocks any other executable from running under these identities.

Device | Owner | Enclave
NW-LT-0412 | J. Ortiz | CUI
NW-LT-0419 | A. Chen | CUI
NW-SRV-DB02 | svc_erp | CUI
Laptops that are not enrolled in Microsoft Intune with a compliant status land on the guest VLAN and cannot reach the CUI VLAN (VLAN 40). The switches enforce this with 802.1X.
The supplier portal of Precision Castings connects to our SFTP server only from its fixed range 203.0.113.0/28, which is listed in the firewall allow list.
On the last day of a worker, HR closes the Workday record. The nightly sync then disables the AD account, and IT collects the badge and the laptop.
Phishing emails often ask you to click a link. Report suspicious messages with the Report Phish button in Outlook.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Accounts lock after 10 failed attempts.
Visitors sign in at the front desk and wear a red badge. An authorized employee escorts them at all times and limits their access to the lobby and conference rooms.
Rule 114 | allow | 203.0.113.0/28 -> NW-SFTP-01 tcp/22 | Precision Castings | reviewed 2026-08-12
System access is granted on least privilege and need to know. Authorized users are responsible for protecting their credentials and devices.
